# artifactapi_local_generic (Resource)

Manages a local ArtifactAPI generic repository for hosting arbitrary files (e.g. rootfs tarballs).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artifactapi_local_generic" "rootfs_images" {
  name        = "rootfs-images"
  description = "Prebuilt node rootfs tarballs (bootapi image provisioning)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the local Generic repository.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import artifactapi_local_generic.rootfs_images rootfs-images
```
